purpose: F2 follow-up: distinguish an active nominal rail plan from noisy nonlinear closed-loop success, without retuning or replacing the existing benchmark
controllerParameters: Retain the r1-q1 baseline, measured Re, original P0 and horizon=30 for every case
invariants: One unchanged uniform-rod MuJoCo WASM plant; no new physics or actuator authority
All full runs use measured position/angle and estimated velocities; true initial velocity is not initialized into the observer
Exact-state probes are only labelled offline model diagnostics, never a claimed sensor-only control result
Nominal force and world rail bounds remain 10 N and 2.4 m; success/score requirements remain the original task's
Report active-constraint coverage as observed. No minimum number of wins or successful runs is required to pass code validation
Matched mirror cases separate directional effects; model-error cases keep the same declared sensor amplitudes
Do not change cases or retune against their results; future reuse is regression evidence
claimBoundary: No global ranking, new optimum, robust safety or hardware admission. Planning feasibility, estimator error, actual envelope failure and task achievement are separate outcomes.
